name: 人物と日別作業数を並べる担当者の負荷行
prompt: Recreate one horizontal Asana workload row from the primary source crop, localized in Japanese, with the source crop as authority for geometry, count positions, colors and visible state. The source region is 1613 × 61 px, about 26.4:1: use a shallow row with no large outer blank canvas, no other people, no header or date labels, no surrounding page, no decorative frame. Left side: a small right-facing expand chevron, a circular avatar matching the source portrait as closely as possible, and the Japanese display name 「山田 花子」. A thin neutral vertical divider separates the person cell from the chart. Right side: preserve the exact distribution of 15 visible values, all 「1」: one isolated early peak, a later close pair, then twelve consecutive daily counts in the long final span. Put each small gray 「1」 at its source position inside a pale lavender workload shape, with the same low trapezoid / gentle peaked segments, thin light-lavender outlines, small hollow circular markers, white date-cell background, and subtle alternating date-cell bands. Include the tiny blue selected-date marker touching the crop's top edge and its fine vertical guide where shown. Preserve the source's calm gray and lavender palette; do not use the mock's green. Use crisp Meiryo-style Japanese UI text at compact regular weight, no bold title. Do not invent dates, tasks, names other than the approved Japanese alias, counts, controls, or status. Keep all 15 ones visible, correctly spaced, on one baseline without wrapping or overlap.
reviewNotes: Reviewed against the Asana source row crop. The candidate retains the chevron, Japanese name alias 山田 花子, one early workload peak, the close pair, and twelve consecutive later counts: 15 visible values of 1 in total. Source lavender chart colors, hollow markers, divider, and clipped blue selected-date marker are present. Material geometry remains: the source is a 1613x61 row, while the generated canvas is a roughly 3:1 landscape with large blank margins and a taller row; the avatar is also larger and its portrait is only an approximation of the original. Keep as a correction-needed raster candidate. Exact font/icon geometry, native editability, and application behavior are not verified.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
